details: audit_c3_mapper_window_sidecar builds the sidecar from chunk cache fallback records and a selected C3 plan.
_build_mapper_window_sidecar_payload writes traced C3 tokens into beatmap/window rows as token_ids.
The exact sidecar report preserves 3,203,904 traced side-stream tokens with zero missing anchors.
MapperV21WindowDataset tokenizes the target beatmap window and optionally adds c3_side_stream_tokens from a beatmap_path/window_start_ms sidecar lookup.
load_c3_side_stream_token_sidecar expects windows with beatmap_path, window_start_ms, and token_ids.
The model embeds c3_side_stream_tokens, mean-pools them, projects them, and adds the result to decoder_hidden.
This is stable in teacher-forced training, but the tokens are target-derived.
generate_full_song_rollout_v2_1 takes control/density context and generated token prefix, but no C3 sidecar input.
mapper_v2_1_logits_fn calls incremental_decode_next_token without C3 side-stream tensors.

p9_training_probe.interpretation: training-stable but not deployable as production input conditioning

what_passed: P9 training stability remains valid as an offline probe.
Current source clearly identifies the inference gap.
what_surfaced: Current C3 conditioning uses target-derived tokens as input.
Generation has no exogenous C3 source.
Incremental decode explicitly rejects C3-conditioned configs.
Further training on this path would not prove full-pipeline deployability.
kill_criteria_triggered: Kill current pooled C3 input-conditioning promotion path for production/default use.
result.next_step: Create a bounded C3 auxiliary-target or target-grammar Experiment Card that predicts or emits C3 RAW/REF/RES structure instead of consuming target-derived sidecar tokens as input.
